title: Movie cast
story: Bonus character cards with the game's cast, two per film genre.

cards.name: Sheriff Pals
cards.subject: The man in a cowboy hat tips it politely while the pig, in a cowboy hat that fits over its ears, holds a tin mug of coffee beside him, both in front of a saloon.
cards.hero_colors: brown hats, pink pig, tin grey mug
cards.surface_or_setting: a boardwalk in front of a saloon

cards.name: Ranch Hands
cards.subject: The cow wears a red bandana, and the rooster wears a tiny cowboy hat with a hole for its comb, standing on a hay bale next to the cow and sharing a bucket of oats.
cards.hero_colors: white and black cow, orange rooster, red bandana, tan hat
cards.surface_or_setting: a hay bale on a ranch yard

cards.name: Bridge Crew
cards.subject: The cow and the rooster in shiny silver space jumpsuits stand at a ship's control desk, the cow happily pressing a big round button while the rooster flaps its wings in delight.
cards.hero_colors: silver jumpsuits, white cow with black spots, orange rooster
cards.backdrop_colors: deep purple-blue spaceship interior with a clear cyan window

cards.name: Sky Watchers
cards.subject: The man and the pig stand on a green meadow at day, both pointing up and waving cheerfully at a small silver flying saucer high in the clear blue sky.
cards.hero_colors: brown mustache man in a blue coverall, pink pig, silver saucer
cards.backdrop_colors: clear sky blue and fresh green

cards.name: Trick Treat
cards.subject: The sheep wearing a white bed sheet ghost costume with two eye holes holds a glowing lantern, while the cow beside it wears a pointed witch hat and carries a candy bucket, both happily knocking on a door at night.
cards.hero_colors: white sheet, white cow with black spots, purple hat
cards.backdrop_colors: rich royal blue night sky with a few small stars and a crescent moon
cards.surface_or_setting: a porch with a lit window

cards.name: Vampire Night
cards.subject: The man in a black vampire cape with a high collar and plastic fangs peeks from behind a curtain while the rooster in a mummy wrap of white bandages waves cheerfully at him.
cards.hero_colors: black cape with red lining, white bandages, orange rooster
cards.backdrop_colors: violet turning pink at the horizon

sources.title: Western
sources.story: Saddle up for a sunny frontier movie night.

cards.name: Cowboy Hat
cards.subject: A brown cowboy hat with a wide curled brim, a creased crown and a red band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: warm brown with a red band

cards.name: Sheriff Star
cards.subject: A gold five-pointed star badge with a small ball on each point, a raised rim and a round red center disc.
cards.hero_colors: gold with a red center disc

cards.name: Cactus
cards.subject: A tall saguaro cactus with a thick vertical trunk, two upturned arms, vertical ribs and a small flower on top.
cards.hero_colors: green with a yellow flower

cards.name: Cowboy Boots
cards.subject: A pair of brown leather cowboy boots with pointed toes, tall stitched shafts, angled heels and a silver spur with a round star-shaped wheel on each heel.
cards.hero_colors: brown leather with silver spurs and red stitching

cards.name: Wagon
cards.subject: A covered wagon with a wooden body, four big spoked wooden wheels with red hubs, a rounded white canvas cover over the bed and a wooden driver bench at the front, standing on a dirt trail.
cards.hero_colors: white canvas and wood brown with red wheel hubs

cards.name: Saloon Doors
cards.subject: A pair of wooden swinging saloon half-doors with slatted tops, seen from the street, hinged on the outer sides of a wooden doorframe, with a lit saloon interior and a warm lamp glowing behind them.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown with a warm yellow glow and a green door trim
cards.surface_or_setting: the front of a wooden saloon on a boardwalk

cards.name: Campfire
cards.subject: A bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, glowing orange ends on the logs, and warm orange light cast on what stands near it, inside a ring of grey stones, with a black metal coffee pot with a handle resting on a stone beside the flames.
cards.hero_colors: orange and yellow flames, brown logs, grey stones, black coffee pot with a red handle grip
cards.surface_or_setting: dusty ground in a ring of stones

cards.name: Wanted Poster
cards.subject: A tan paper poster nailed at its four corners to a wooden plank wall, showing a simple black bandit mask icon in the middle.
cards.hero_colors: tan paper with a black mask icon, grey nails

cards.name: Sheriff Pals
cards.subject: The man in a cowboy hat tips it politely while the pig, in a cowboy hat that fits over its ears, holds a tin mug of coffee beside him, both in front of a saloon.
cards.hero_colors: brown hats, pink pig, tin grey mug
cards.surface_or_setting: a boardwalk in front of a saloon

cards.surface_or_setting: a hay bale on a ranch yard

sources.title: Sci-Fi
sources.story: Lights down, the space adventure begins.
declined: robot and alien objects: creatures with faces count as characters

cards.name: Rocket
cards.subject: A flying rocket with a white pointed nose cone, a red body with two round porthole windows, three red fins at the base and a bright fire trail below it, flying upward.
cards.hero_colors: white and red, with yellow portholes

cards.name: Moon Rover
cards.subject: A six-wheeled moon rover with a boxy white body, a small round dish antenna on a short mast fixed to the roof and a camera on the front, standing on grey metal deck plates.
cards.hero_colors: white and silver, with orange wheel hubs

cards.name: Space Helmet
cards.subject: A round white astronaut helmet with a big curved gold visor, a ribbed neck ring at the bottom and a small air port on the side.
cards.hero_colors: white and gold, with an orange stripe on the neck ring

cards.name: Airlock
cards.subject: A round steel airlock hatch with a thick rim, a small round porthole in the middle and a spoked turning wheel on the side opposite the hinges, set into a bolted spaceship wall.
cards.hero_colors: steel grey, with a red wheel
cards.surface_or_setting: a riveted grey spaceship corridor wall

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A flying saucer with a wide silver disc body, a round glass dome on top and a ring of small round lights around the rim, flying in a clear sky.
cards.hero_colors: silver and light grey, with yellow rim lights

cards.name: Lab Flask
cards.subject: A round-bottom glass lab flask with a long neck, filled with glowing green liquid with a few bubbles, closed with a cork stopper.
cards.hero_colors: glowing green liquid in clear glass, with a light brown cork

cards.name: Star Map
cards.subject: A flat rectangular star map lying on a table, blue with white dots joined by thin lines into constellations and a small ringed-planet icon in one corner.
cards.hero_colors: deep blue and white, with yellow dots

cards.name: Control Panel
cards.subject: A wall-mounted control panel with a slanted face, a square screen showing a wave icon, a row of round buttons, two sliders and a big lever, bolted to a spaceship wall.
cards.hero_colors: slate blue, with yellow buttons

cards.name: Bridge Crew
cards.subject: The cow and the rooster in shiny silver space jumpsuits stand at a ship's control desk, the cow happily pressing a big round button while the rooster flaps its wings in delight.
cards.hero_colors: silver jumpsuits, white cow with black spots, orange rooster
cards.backdrop_colors: deep purple-blue spaceship interior with a clear cyan window

cards.hero_colors: brown mustache man in a blue coverall, pink pig, silver saucer
cards.backdrop_colors: clear sky blue and fresh green

sources.title: Horror
sources.story: A spooky movie night where everything is friendly fun.

cards.name: Jack Lantern
cards.subject: A round orange pumpkin with a short green stem, carved with triangle eyes, a nose and a jagged grinning mouth, glowing warm yellow from inside, sitting on weathered wooden porch planks.
cards.hero_colors: orange pumpkin, warm yellow glow, green stem

cards.name: Witch Hat
cards.subject: A tall pointed witch hat with a wide round brim, a slightly bent tip and a band around the base of the crown.
cards.hero_colors: deep purple hat, small yellow band

cards.name: Bat
cards.subject: A bat flying with both wings spread wide, with scalloped wing edges, small pointed ears, a tiny face and a furry round body.
cards.hero_colors: dark grey-brown fur and wings, small light tan belly
cards.backdrop_colors: dusk sky, violet turning pink at the horizon

cards.name: Candelabra
cards.subject: A silver candelabra with a round base, a central stem and three curved arms, each holding a cream candle topped with a bright fire with a yellow-white glowing core, orange flame tips curling upward, and warm orange light cast on the silver.
cards.hero_colors: silver candelabra, cream candles, orange flames

cards.name: Witch Broom
cards.subject: A witch broom lying flat seen from above, with a long straight wooden handle and a bundle of tan straw bristles tied tight to the handle's end with twine.
cards.hero_colors: wood brown handle, tan straw bristles, small red twine binding

cards.name: Crystal Ball
cards.subject: A round glass crystal ball filled with swirling teal mist, resting in a dark wooden stand with three curled feet that touch the ground.
cards.hero_colors: pale violet glass, teal mist swirl, dark brown wooden stand

cards.name: Haunted Door
cards.subject: A tall arched old wooden front door seen from outside, with a big round iron knocker in the middle, a handle on the right with hinges on the left, a small round window glowing warm yellow, set in a stone wall with one stone step.
cards.hero_colors: dark wood brown door, grey stone wall, glowing yellow window
cards.backdrop_colors: rich royal blue night sky with a few small stars and a crescent moon
cards.surface_or_setting: the stone front wall of an old house with a stone doorstep

cards.name: Old Clock
cards.subject: A tall wooden grandfather clock with a perfectly round white face with numbers, two hands pointing to midnight, a glass door showing a swinging brass pendulum, and a pointed top.
cards.hero_colors: dark wood brown case, cream face, red clock hands, brass pendulum
cards.surface_or_setting: a wooden hallway floor against a plain wall
